verdict.rationale: The docs say a CSV upload is "a first-class way in, not a fallback" and that you can upload a CSV export from a system cfo.ai does not connect to so its rows feed the Model. A Google Sheet, or an Excel or CSV file in Google Drive, can also be connected so Ari imports it and updates the Model when the file changes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail on how uploaded rows and columns are mapped or validated into the Model.
